title: Swimming
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Creative Arts; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Pool work only with a trained adult; questions ask for body position and actions.

skills.key_step: The child describes breaststroke: body flat and face down, arms pull round to the shoulders together, frog kick, breathe as the arms pull, glide.

floor.question: In front crawl, do the arms move together?

steps: Arms pull out and round together.

board.do: Do the arms move together in breaststroke?
Write the order: pull, breathe, kick, glide.

misconceptions.ask: How does the body lie in breaststroke?
misconceptions.repair: Name the four strokes and how the body lies in each.

listen_for: A flutter kick, up and down
misconceptions.ask: What kind of kick is used in breaststroke?
misconceptions.repair: Sit on a bench and practise both kicks.
List the rules of the water with the teacher.

misconceptions.ask: In breaststroke, how far back do the arms pull?
misconceptions.repair: Practise a small heart-shaped pull on land.

checks.question: Which kick is used in breaststroke?
When do you breathe in breaststroke?
